attributes.description: Distinct services emitting logs in the selected time window. This is not a service uptime or health check.
attributes.title: 04 · Observed services

attributes.description: Stacked timeline of log volume by normalized service. Top 20 services with the remaining services grouped under Other. Use a chart selection or service control to investigate.
attributes.title: 05 · Log volume by service

attributes.description: All events by normalized severity. INFO green, WARN amber, ERROR red, UNKNOWN gray. UNKNOWN means no structured severity.
attributes.title: 06 · Severity distribution

attributes.description: ERROR/FATAL event counts by service over time. Click a time range or service to narrow the investigation.
attributes.title: 07 · Errors over time by service

attributes.description: Per-service log totals, ERROR/FATAL count, WARN count and log error ratio. Color intensity highlights relative error rates. Select a service to filter the dashboard.
attributes.title: 08 · Service log health

attributes.description: Latest application and infrastructure logs, newest first. Unified service and severity, full message, logger, trace ID and source. Expand a row for stack traces and all original fields. Inherits dashboard filters and time range.
attributes.title: Log Explorer | Service • Severity • Trace

attributes.description: How to filter, search and investigate application and infrastructure logs.

{"title":"00 · Log operations guide","type":"markdown","aggs":[],"params":{"fontSize":12,"openLinksInNewTab":false,"markdown":"## VIGO · LOG OPERATIONS
**Observe → isolate → investigate**

Choose a **Service**, **Severity** or **Source** above. Select a time range on a chart, then inspect matching events in **Log Explorer** below. Expand any row for the full message and stack trace.

**ERROR / FATAL** = errors · **WARN** = warnings · **UNKNOWN** = no structured severity. Error rate is errors ÷ log events. Observed services measures log activity.

Quick search: `message: "timeout"` · `traceId: "your-trace-id"`"}}

attributes.description: Operational log monitoring across application and infrastructure services. Unified service/severity filters, volume trends, error analysis and a searchable log explorer. ERROR/FATAL defines errors; UNKNOWN means no structured severity. Service counts indicate observed logs, not service uptime.
